name: Bengaluru
aliases: Bangalore, Bengalooru, Bangalore City
description: The capital city of Karnataka, known as India's high-tech hub, celebrated for its pleasant climate, vibrant parks, historical monuments, and cosmopolitan culture.

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
aliases: Lalbagh, Lal Bagh, Lalbagh Glass House
description: Historic 240-acre botanical garden commissioned by Hyder Ali in 1760, featuring a famous glass house inspired by London's Crystal Palace and rare tropical plants.

name: Cubbon Park
aliases: Sri Chamarajendra Park, Cubbon Park Bangalore
description: Lush 300-acre public park in the heart of Bengaluru, established in 1870, home to historic administrative buildings and rich floral diversity.

name: Bangalore Palace
aliases: Bengaluru Palace
description: Tudor-style royal palace built in 1887 by Chamaraja Wadiyar, renowned for its fortified towers, woodcarvings, and Victorian interiors.

name: Bannerghatta National Park
aliases: Bannerghatta Biological Park, Bannerghatta Zoo, Bannerghatta Safari
description: Biological park and national sanctuary on Bengaluru's southern edge featuring tiger, lion, and herbivore safaris, a zoo, and India's first butterfly park.

name: ISKCON Temple Bangalore
aliases: ISKCON Bangalore, Sri Radha Krishna Temple Rajajinagar, Hare Krishna Hill
description: One of the largest ISKCON temples in the world, situated atop Hare Krishna Hill in Rajajinagar, dedicated to Radha Krishna and Krishna Balarama.

name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
aliases: Tipu Summer Palace, Tipu Sultan Palace Bangalore
description: Exemplary Indo-Islamic teakwood palace completed in 1791 within the Bengaluru Fort complex by Tipu Sultan.

name: Bull Temple
aliases: Dodda Basavana Gudi, Nandi Temple Basavanagudi, Basavanagudi Bull Temple
description: Historic 16th-century temple built by Kempe Gowda I in Basavanagudi, housing a massive monolithic granite idol of Nandi.

name: Devanahalli Fort
aliases: Devanahalli, Tipu Sultan Birthplace Fort
description: Historic 15th-century stone fort and birthplace of Tipu Sultan, located near Kempegowda International Airport.

name: Ghati Subramanya
aliases: Ghati Subramanya Temple, Subramanya Ghati
description: Ancient pilgrimage temple near Doddaballapura where the deity Lord Subramanya and Lord Lakshmi Narasimha emerge from a single monolithic idol.

name: Makalidurga
aliases: Makalidurga Fort, Makalidurga Trek, Makalidurga Hill
description: Popular trekking destination featuring a hilltop fort ruin with panoramic views of the curving railway line and scenic lake below.

name: Shivagange
aliases: Shivaganga, Shivagange Betta, Dakshina Kashi
description: A conical rocky hill rising to 1,368 meters, known as Dakshina Kashi, featuring cave temples of Gavisiddheshwara and Honnadevi alongside panoramic views.

name: Mysuru
aliases: Mysore, Mysuru City
description: The heritage city and former royal capital of the Wadiyar dynasty, world-famous for its grand palace, Dasara festival, silk sarees, and sandalwood.

name: Mysore Palace
aliases: Amba Vilas Palace, Mysuru Palace, Mysore Royal Palace
description: Magnificent Indo-Saracenic royal palace designed by Henry Irwin, decorated with rosewood doors, stained glass, and illuminated with nearly 100,000 bulbs.

name: Chamundi Hill
aliases: Chamundeshwari Temple, Chamundi Betta, Chamundi Hills Mysore
description: Prominent hill overlooking Mysuru, crowned by the historic Sri Chamundeshwari Temple and the colossal monolithic Nandi statue along the stone steps.

name: Mysore Zoo
aliases: Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens, Mysuru Zoo
description: One of India's oldest and most well-maintained zoos, established in 1892, housing a vast collection of exotic and native wildlife species.

name: Karanji Lake
aliases: Karanji Kere, Karanji Lake Nature Park
description: Picturesque lake surrounding Chamundi Hills featuring India's largest walk-through aviary, butterfly park, and boating facilities.

name: St. Philomena's Cathedral
aliases: St Philomena Church Mysore, Saint Philomenas Cathedral
description: Imposing Neo-Gothic Catholic church constructed in 1936 with twin 175-foot spires inspired by Germany's Cologne Cathedral.

name: Jaganmohan Palace
aliases: Jayachamarajendra Art Gallery, Jaganmohan Palace Art Gallery
description: Royal palace built in 1861 housing an exceptional art gallery with masterpieces by Raja Ravi Varma and royal artifacts.

name: Srirangapatna
aliases: Srirangapatnam, Srirangapattana, Srirangapatna Fort
description: Historic river island fortress city on the Kaveri River, former capital of Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan, home to the ancient Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple and Gumbaz.

name: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary
aliases: Ranganathittu, Ranganatittu
description: Renowned bird sanctuary on six islets of the Kaveri River, hosting painted storks, spoonbills, pelicans, and marsh crocodiles on guided boat safaris.

name: Shivanasamudra Falls
aliases: Shivanasamudra, Sivasamudram, Gaganachukki, Bharachukki, Gaganachukki and Bharachukki
description: Spectacular segmented waterfalls on the Kaveri River spanning Mandya and Chamarajanagar districts, dividing into Gaganachukki and Bharachukki cascades, and site of Asia's first hydroelectric power station.

name: Brindavan Gardens
aliases: Brindavan Garden, KRS Brindavan Gardens
description: Famous terrace garden adjacent to the Krishnarajasagara Dam, celebrated for symmetrical botanical lawns, illuminated fountains, and musical water shows.

name: Krishna Raja Sagara Dam
aliases: KRS Dam, Krishnarajasagara, KRS Reservoir
description: Major gravity dam across the Kaveri River engineered under Sir M. Visvesvaraya, forming the primary reservoir for Mysuru and Bengaluru.

name: Melukote
aliases: Melkote, Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple, Yoga Narasimha Temple Melukote
description: Sacred hilltop town revered in Sri Vaishnavism, home to the ancient Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple, the hilltop Yoga Narasimha Temple, and Kalyani tank.

name: Kokkare Bellur
aliases: Kokkarebellur Pelican Sanctuary, Kokkare Bellur Bird Village
description: Unique heritage bird village where spot-billed pelicans and painted storks nest in harmony alongside village houses and tamarind trees.

name: Sakleshpur
aliases: Sakleshpura, Sakaleshpura, Sakleshpura Town, Sakleshpur Hill Station
description: Charming Western Ghats hill station known for lush coffee plantations, spice estates, rolling green hills, mist-covered viewpoints, and trekking trails.

name: Belur
aliases: Chennakeshava Temple Belur, Beluru, Velapuri
description: Historic capital of the Hoysala Empire on the Yagachi River, celebrated for the 12th-century UNESCO World Heritage Chennakeshava Temple with intricate soapstone filigree.

name: Halebidu
aliases: Halebeedu, Dwarasamudra, Hoysaleshwara Temple Halebidu, Halebid
description: UNESCO World Heritage Hoysala capital famed for the twin Hoysaleshwara and Shantaleshwara temples with elaborate relief carvings and friezes.

name: Shravanabelagola
aliases: Sravanabelagola, Gommateshwara, Bahubali Monolith, Vindhyagiri
description: World-renowned Jain pilgrimage center home to the 57-foot-tall monolithic statue of Lord Gommateshwara (Bahubali) carved in 981 AD atop Vindhyagiri Hill.

name: Manjarabad Fort
aliases: Manjarabad Star Fort, Sakleshpur Star Fort
description: Unique eight-pointed star fort built in 1792 by Tipu Sultan on a hilltop near Sakleshpur, offering views extending towards the Arabian Sea on clear days.

name: Bisle Ghat
aliases: Bisle View Point, Bisle Reserve Forest, Bisle Ghat Trek
description: Breathtaking Western Ghats vantage point offering sweeping vistas of three mountain ranges: Kumara Parvatha, Pushpagiri, and Dodda Betta.

name: Shettihalli Rosary Church
aliases: Shettihalli Church, The Drowning Church, Submerged Church Hassan
description: Gothic 1860s French church ruin on the Hemavathi Reservoir banks that becomes partially submerged during monsoons and re-emerges in summer.

name: Chikkamagaluru
aliases: Chikmagalur, Chikkamagaluru City
description: Scenic Western Ghats hill station widely regarded as the birthplace of coffee in India, surrounded by cloud-kissed peaks and sprawling estate plantations.

name: Mullayanagiri
aliases: Mullayanagiri Peak, Mullayyana Giri
description: The highest peak in Karnataka at 1,930 meters (6,330 ft), featuring a sage Mullappa Swamy temple at the summit and sweeping trekking trails.

name: Baba Budangiri
aliases: Chandra Drona Parvatha, Dattagiri, Baba Budangiri Hills, Inam Dattatreya Peetha
description: Sacred mountain range revered by both Hindus and Muslims, named after Sufi saint Baba Budan who brought the first coffee seeds to India.

name: Kudremukh
aliases: Kudremukh National Park, Kuduremukha, Kudremukh Peak Trek
description: Iconic horse-face-shaped mountain peak (1,894m) and UNESCO biodiversity hotspot national park sheltering shola-grassland ecosystems.

name: Kemmangundi
aliases: Kemmannugundi, KR Hills, Sri Krishnarajendra Hill Station
description: Picturesque hill station situated at 1,434 meters amidst the Baba Budan range, once the summer retreat of Maharaja Krishnaraja Wadiyar IV.

name: Hebbe Falls
aliases: Hebbe Waterfalls, Dodda Hebbe, Chikka Hebbe
description: Enchanting 551-foot two-stage waterfall tucked inside a coffee estate near Kemmangundi, accessible via thrilling jeep rides and nature trails.

name: Sringeri
aliases: Sringeri Sharada Peetham, Sri Sharadamba Temple Sringeri, Sringeri Mutt
description: Historic pilgrimage center on the Tunga River, home to the premier southern monastic seat established by Adi Shankaracharya in the 8th century.

name: Horanadu
aliases: Hornadu, Annapoorneshwari Temple Horanadu, Sri Kshethra Horanadu
description: Sacred temple village nestled amid verdant Western Ghats hills, dedicated to Goddess Annapoorneshwari, provider of sustenance.

name: Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary
aliases: Muthodi Wildlife Sanctuary, Bhadra Tiger Reserve
description: Protected tiger reserve and wildlife haven encompassing dry deciduous to moist evergreen forests around the Bhadra Reservoir.

name: Kodagu
aliases: Coorg, Kodagu District, Madikeri Region
description: Picturesque hill district and region in southwestern Karnataka celebrated for mist-clad coffee estates, spice plantations, lush rainforests, and martial Kodava culture.

name: Madikeri
aliases: Mercara, Madikeri Town, Madikeri Fort
description: The picturesque hill capital of Kodagu district, featuring Madikeri Fort, Raja's Seat, Omkareshwara Temple, and panoramic viewpoints.

name: Raja's Seat
aliases: Rajas Seat Madikeri, Raja Seat Viewpoint
description: Historic garden and seasonal flower pavilion in Madikeri where Kodagu kings enjoyed spectacular sunsets over undulating green valleys.

name: Abbey Falls
aliases: Abbi Falls, Jessy Falls, Abbey Falls Madikeri
description: Spectacular cascade on the Kaveri River tributary gushing amid private coffee and spice plantations, viewed from a hanging bridge.

name: Talakaveri
aliases: Talacauvery, Talakaveri Temple, Brahmagiri Hills Coorg
description: The sacred source of the holy Kaveri River, located at an elevation of 1,276 meters on the slopes of Brahmagiri Hill.

name: Bhagamandala
aliases: Bhagandeshwara Temple, Triveni Sangama Bhagamandala
description: Holy pilgrimage confluence of three rivers (Kaveri, Kannike, and mythological Sujyothi) crowned by the Kerala-style Sri Bhagandeshwara Temple.

name: Dubare Elephant Camp
aliases: Dubare, Dubare Forest, Dubare Kaveri Camp
description: Famous elephant training camp on the banks of the Kaveri River offering bathing, feeding, and river rafting interactions.

name: Namdroling Monastery
aliases: Golden Temple Bylakuppe, Bylakuppe Tibetan Settlement, Namdroling Nyingmapa Monastery
description: The largest teaching center of the Nyingma lineage of Tibetan Buddhism, located in Bylakuppe (Mysuru district near the Kushalnagar/Kodagu tourism gateway), featuring three 40-foot golden Buddha statues and vibrant murals.

name: Nagarhole National Park
aliases: Rajiv Gandhi National Park Nagarhole, Nagarhole Tiger Reserve, Nagarahole
description: Premier tiger and elephant reserve spanning Mysuru and Kodagu districts along the Kabini River, part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve with rich populations of leopards and wild dogs.

name: Tadiandamol
aliases: Tadiyandamol Peak, Tadiandamol Trek
description: The highest peak in Kodagu district at 1,748 meters, offering a scenic trek through shola forests and misty ridges near Nalaknad Palace.

name: Iruppu Falls
aliases: Irupu Falls, Lakshmana Tirtha Falls, Iruppu Waterfalls
description: Sacred freshwater cascade originating from the Lakshmana Tirtha stream in Brahmagiri range, adjoining the Rameshwara temple.

name: Mandalpatti
aliases: Mandalpatti Peak, Mugilu Pette, Mandalpatti View Point
description: Spectacular hilltop viewpoint overlooking Pushpagiri wildlife sanctuary, famous for off-road 4x4 jeep rides through lush green rolling hills.

name: Bandipur National Park
aliases: Bandipur Tiger Reserve, Bandipur Safari, Bandipura
description: Renowned national park established under Project Tiger in 1974, home to the second-highest tiger population in India alongside Asian elephants and gaurs.

name: BR Hills
aliases: Biligirirangana Hills, Biligiriranga Hills, BRT Wildlife Sanctuary, Biligiriranganatha Swamy Temple
description: Ecological bridge connecting the Eastern and Western Ghats, featuring endemic wildlife, Soliga tribal culture, and the hilltop Biligiriranganatha temple.

name: Himavad Gopalaswamy Betta
aliases: Gopalaswamy Betta, Himavad Gopalaswamy Temple
description: The highest peak in Bandipur National Park (1,454m), shrouded in perpetual morning fog, featuring an ancient 14th-century temple dedicated to Lord Krishna.

name: Male Mahadeshwara Hills
aliases: MM Hills, Malai Mahadeshwara Betta, MM Hills Temple
description: Major Shaivite pilgrimage center set in deep forested hills on the border of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, dedicated to Lord Male Mahadeshwara.

name: Nandi Hills
aliases: Nandidurga, Nandi Betta, Nandi Hills Sunrise, Tipu's Drop Nandi Hills
description: Ancient hill fortress rising 1,478 meters, famous for sunrise views above the cloud layer, Tipu's Drop, and historic summer residences.

name: Skandagiri
aliases: Kalavara Durga, Skandagiri Sunrise
description: Popular mountain peak famous for overnight wilderness treks to witness the sunrise over an ethereal blanket of morning clouds.

name: Bhoga Nandeeshwara Temple
aliases: Nandi Temple Nandi Village, Bhoganandishwara Temple
description: Magnificent 9th-century temple complex at the foot of Nandi Hills representing architecture from Nolamba, Rashtrakuta, Chola, Hoysala, and Vijayanagara eras.

name: Kotilingeshwara Temple
aliases: Kotilingeshwara, Kammasandra Temple
description: Famed Hindu temple complex in Kammasandra village housing one of the world's largest Shiva Lingas (108 ft) surrounded by millions of smaller lingas.

name: Kolar Gold Fields
aliases: KGF, Champion Reef, Kolar Mining Town
description: Historic gold mining region known for its colonial Anglo-Indian architecture, century-old underground shafts, and heritage township.

name: Antaragange
aliases: Anthargange, Antargange Cave Trek, Kolar Shathashrunga
description: Unique mountain formation composed of volcanic granite boulders, cave systems, and a perennial sacred freshwater spring.

name: Ramanagara
aliases: Ramnagaram, Ramadevara Betta Vulture Sanctuary
description: Famous for massive granite outcrops, silk production, rock climbing, and the iconic filming location of the classic Bollywood movie Sholay.

name: Janapada Loka
aliases: Janapadaloka
description: Extensive open-air folk culture museum dedicated to preserving and showcasing Karnataka's vibrant rural arts, crafts, and heritage traditions.

name: Savandurga
aliases: Savandurga Monolith, Savandurga Trek, Karigudda and Biligudda
description: One of the largest monolithic granite hills in Asia, rising 1,226 meters above sea level, featuring hill fortress ruins built by Kempe Gowda II.

name: Mekedatu
aliases: Mekedatu Gorge, Sangama and Mekedatu
description: Deep, narrow rocky gorge where the Kaveri River rushes with immense power, named 'Goat's Leap' from legend.

name: Devarayanadurga
aliases: DD Hills, Devarayanadurga Hill, Yoga Narasimha Temple DD Hills
description: Forested hill station at 1,204 meters surrounded by rocky hillocks, featuring the Bhoga and Yoga Narasimha temples and Namada Chilume spring.

name: Madhugiri Fort
aliases: Madhugiri Monolith, Madhugiri Betta Trek
description: Asia's second largest monolithic granite hill (1,200m), crowned by a multi-tiered fortress built by Raja Heera Gowda and fortified by Hyder Ali.

name: Hampi
aliases: Vijayanagara, Hampe, Kishkindha, Hampi Ruins, UNESCO World Heritage Hampi
description: Spectacular UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring ruins of the medieval Vijayanagara Empire across surreal boulder-strewn landscapes along the Tungabhadra River.

name: Virupaksha Temple
aliases: Hampi Virupaksha, Pampapathi Temple Hampi
description: Continuously active 7th-century Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva as Virupaksha, featuring a 50-meter eastern gateway gopuram.

name: Vijaya Vittala Temple
aliases: Vittala Temple Hampi, Stone Chariot Hampi, Musical Pillars Temple
description: Masterpiece of Vijayanagara architecture renowned for its iconic Stone Chariot (featured on India's ₹50 banknote) and 56 melodic musical pillars.

name: Lotus Mahal
aliases: Kamal Mahal Hampi, Lotus Temple Zenana Enclosure
description: Exquisite two-story Indo-Islamic pavilion in the Zenana Enclosure, styled like an unfurling lotus bud with recessed arches and natural water cooling.

name: Elephant Stables
aliases: Hampi Elephant Stables, Royal Stables Hampi
description: Monumental Indo-Islamic building comprising 11 interconnected domed chambers used to house the royal state elephants of the Vijayanagara kings.

name: Matanga Hill
aliases: Matanga Betta
description: The highest point in Hampi offering incomparable 360-degree views of the sprawling ruins, Tungabhadra River, and Achyutaraya Temple at dawn and dusk.

name: Tungabhadra Dam
aliases: TB Dam Hospet, Tungabhadra Reservoir, Hospet Dam
description: Majestic multipurpose dam across the Tungabhadra River near Hosapete, featuring musical fountain gardens, watchtowers, and panoramic water vistas.

name: Badami
aliases: Vatapi, Badami Cave Temples, Badami Rock Cut Caves
description: Regal 6th-century capital of the Early Chalukya dynasty, famous for rock-cut cave temples carved into red sandstone cliffs surrounding Agastya Lake.

name: Aihole
aliases: Aryapura, Durga Temple Aihole
description: Historic town containing over 120 stone and rock-cut temples dating from the 4th to 12th century, known as the laboratory of Indian temple architecture.

name: Pattadakal
aliases: Pattadakallu, Raktapura, UNESCO Pattadakal Monuments
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site on the Malaprabha River showcasing a harmonious blend of Dravidian and Nagara temple architectural traditions.

name: Banashankari Temple
aliases: Banashankari Amma Temple Badami, Shakambhari Temple Cholachagudda
description: Historic 7th-century temple dedicated to Goddess Banashankari located in Cholachagudda near Badami, featuring the Haridra Tirtha water tank.

name: Mahakuta
aliases: Mahakuteshwara Temple, Mahakuta Temples
description: Peaceful early Chalukyan temple complex set in a forested grove, famous for the Pushkarini spring-fed sacred pool and Shiva shrines.

name: Gokak Falls
aliases: Gokak Waterfalls, Ghataprabha Falls
description: Dramatic 52-meter horseshoe-shaped waterfall on the Ghataprabha River, featuring a colonial suspension bridge and historic sandstone temples.

name: Belagavi Fort
aliases: Belgaum Fort, Kamal Basti Belgaum
description: 12th-century stone fort originally built by the Ratta dynasty, featuring ancient Jain temples (Kamala Basadi), historic mosques, and lush moats.

name: Kittur Fort
aliases: Kittur, Rani Chennamma Fort Kittur, Kittur Palace
description: Historical stronghold of Queen Rani Chennamma who fought against the British East India Company in 1824, housing an archaeological museum.

name: Yellamma Temple Saundatti
aliases: Saundatti Yellamma, Renuka Yellamma Temple, Savadatti
description: One of the most frequented pilgrimage shrines in northern Karnataka, dedicated to Goddess Renuka (Yellamma) atop Yellammagudda hill.

name: Gokarna
aliases: Gokarna Beach, Mahabaleshwara Temple Gokarna
description: Sacred coastal pilgrimage town and pristine beach haven, famed for the Atmalinga at Sri Mahabaleshwara Temple and secluded trekking beaches.

name: Om Beach
aliases: Ohm Beach Gokarna, Om Beach Trek
description: Famous natural crescent beach in Gokarna shaped like the spiritual Hindu 'Om' (🕉️) symbol, renowned for sea walks and water sports.

name: Kudle Beach
aliases: Kudle Gokarna, Cooldle Beach
description: Wide, crescent sandy beach enclosed by green headlands, ideal for relaxing sunsets, yoga, and cliff-walk connectivity to Om Beach.

name: Murudeshwar
aliases: Murudeshwara, Murdeshwar Temple
description: Iconic seaside pilgrimage destination featuring the world's second-tallest Shiva statue (123 ft) and the towering 20-story Raja Gopura overlooking the Arabian Sea.

name: Dandeli
aliases: Dandeli Wildlife Sanctuary, Dandeli River Rafting, Kali River Dandeli
description: Adventure capital of Karnataka situated on the Kali River, famous for white-water rafting, jungle safaris, black panther sightings, and birdwatching.

name: Yana Rocks
aliases: Yana Caves, Bhairaveshwara Shikhara, Mohini Shikhara Yana
description: Two massive monolithic black karst rock towers rising dramatically out of dense Sahyadri rainforests, housing a natural cave shrine.

name: Mirjan Fort
aliases: Mirjan Kota, Rani Chennabhairadevi Fort
description: Scenic 16th-century laterite fort built along the Aghanashini River by Queen Chennabhairadevi (the 'Pepper Queen'), known for its high bastions and moat.

name: Karwar
aliases: Karwar Beach, Rabindranath Tagore Beach Karwar, Kali River Bridge
description: Peaceful port city on the Goa-Karnataka border praised by Rabindranath Tagore, famous for pristine beaches, INS Chapal warship museum, and seafood.

name: Udupi
aliases: Udupi Town, Temple Town Udupi, Odipu
description: Renowned temple town and culinary capital of coastal Karnataka, birthplace of Udupi cuisine, and home to the sacred 13th-century Sri Krishna Matha.

name: Sri Krishna Matha
aliases: Udupi Krishna Temple, Kanakana Kindi, Udupi Sri Krishna Mutt
description: Major Dvaita Vedanta pilgrimage monastery founded by saint Madhvacharya, where Lord Krishna's idol is viewed exclusively through the nine-holed silver window (Kanakana Kindi).

name: Malpe Beach
aliases: Malpe Beach Udupi
description: Vibrant coastal harbor and beach known for golden sands, parasailing, water sports, and India's first sea-walk way.

name: St. Mary's Island
aliases: St Marys Islands, Coconut Island, Thonsepar
description: Unique geological monument of four uninhabited islands off Malpe, famous for distinct hexagonal columnar basaltic rock formations formed millions of years ago.

name: Kaup Beach
aliases: Kapu Beach, Kaup Lighthouse, Kapu Sea Beach
description: Scenic rocky beach dominated by a functional 1901 British lighthouse offering sweeping vistas of the Arabian Sea coastline.

name: Maravanthe Beach
aliases: Maravanthe, NH66 Maravanthe
description: Stunning scenic coastal highway stretch where NH 66 runs with the Arabian Sea on one side and the calm Souparnika River on the other.

name: Kollur Mookambika Temple
aliases: Kollur, Mookambika Temple Kollur, Sri Mookambika Temple
description: Revered Shakti pilgrimage shrine situated at the foothills of Kodachadri, dedicated to Goddess Mookambika, patron of arts and learning.

name: Mangaluru
aliases: Mangalore, Kudla, Mangaluru Port
description: Major port city and commercial hub of coastal Karnataka, celebrated for distinct Tuluva heritage, pristine beaches, and rich coastal delicacies.

name: Panambur Beach
aliases: Panamburu Beach, Mangalore Port Beach
description: Safe, well-maintained beach near New Mangalore Port, famous for camel rides, jet skis, and the annual International Kite Festival.

name: Tannirbhavi Beach
aliases: Tannirbhavi
description: Tranquil sandy beach accessible via scenic ferry across the Gurupura River, flanked by a lush coastal tree park.

name: Dharmasthala
aliases: Sri Manjunatha Swamy Temple Dharmasthala, Dharmastala, Shri Kshetra Dharmasthala
description: Renowned temple town on the Netravati River, exemplifying communal harmony where Jain Heggade administrators manage the shrine of Lord Shiva (Manjunatha).

name: Kukke Subramanya
aliases: Subramanya, Kukke Sri Subramanya Temple, Kukke
description: Ancient sacred temple nestled in the foothills of Kumara Parvatha on the Kumaradhara River, dedicated to Lord Subramanya as the protector from Sarpa Dosha.

name: Kateel
aliases: Kateel Durga Parameshwari Temple, Kateelu, Nandini River Kateel
description: Sacred island temple dedicated to Goddess Durga Parameshwari, located on a natural islet in the middle of the flowing Nandini River.

name: Moodabidri
aliases: Moodbidri, Thousand Pillar Temple, Tribhuvana Tilaka Chudamani
description: Jain Kashi of the South, renowned for the 1430 AD Thousand Pillar Basadi (Saavira Kambada Basadi) where no two stone pillars share identical carving.

name: Jog Falls
aliases: Gerosoppa Falls, Joga, Raja Roarer Rocket Rani, Sharavathi Falls
description: Second-highest plunge waterfall in India (253 meters) on the Sharavathi River, composed of four distinct cascades: Raja, Roarer, Rocket, and Rani.

name: Shivamogga
aliases: Shimoga, Gateway to Malnad, Shimoga City
description: The gateway city to the verdant Malnad region on the Tunga River, surrounded by rivers, waterfalls, dense forests, and wildlife reserves.

name: Agumbe
aliases: Agumbe Rainforest Research Station
description: High-rainfall Western Ghats village known as the 'Cherrapunji of the South', famous for King Cobra ecology, dense rainforests, and spectacular sunsets over the Arabian Sea.

name: Kodachadri
aliases: Kodachadri Peak, Kodachadri Trek, Sarvajna Peetha Kodachadri
description: Natural heritage mountain peak (1,343m) covered in shola rainforests, where Adi Shankaracharya meditated at the Sarvajna Peetha.

name: Sigandur
aliases: Sigandur Chowdeshwari Temple, Siganduru, Sharavathi Backwaters Sigandur
description: Revered temple village on the backwaters of the Sharavathi River, famous for Goddess Chowdeshwari and scenic barge-ferry crossings.

name: Sakrebyle Elephant Camp
aliases: Sakrebailu, Sakrebyle Camp Shimoga, Tunga Elephant Camp
description: Renowned forest department elephant camp on the Tunga River backwaters where captive and rehabilitated wild elephants bathe and interact.

name: Chitradurga Fort
aliases: Chitradurga, Kallina Kote, Elusuttina Kote, Onake Obavana Kindi
description: Monumental impregnable stone fortress featuring seven circular concentric defense walls, 18 temples, intricate rainwater harvesting tanks, and the legendary Onake Obavva crevice.

name: Vani Vilas Sagar
aliases: Marikanive Dam, Vani Vilasa Sagara
description: The oldest dam in Karnataka, constructed across the Vedavathi River in 1907 by the Mysore Maharajas, showcasing stone masonry architecture.

name: Bidar Fort
aliases: Bidar, Sultanate Fort Bidar, Bahmani Fort Bidar
description: Massive 15th-century Bahmani Sultanate citadel featuring triple-moat defenses, Rangin Mahal woodcraft with Persian mother-of-pearl inlays, and the Solah Khamba mosque.

name: Mahmud Gawan Madrasa
aliases: Madrasa of Mahmud Gawan, Mahmud Gawan Bidar
description: Ancient medieval Islamic university built in 1472 by Prime Minister Mahmud Gawan, adorned with Persian glazed ceramic blue tiles and towering minarets.

name: Gurudwara Nanak Jhira Sahib
aliases: Nanak Jhira Bidar, Gurdwara Nanak Jhira Sahib
description: Major Sikh historical pilgrimage shrine built alongside a miraculous freshwater spring created by Guru Nanak Dev Ji during his southern travels.

name: Vijayapura
aliases: Bijapur
description: Historic royal capital of the Adil Shahi Sultanate, world-famous for grand Islamic architecture, acoustic whispering domes, and imposing fort walls.

name: Gol Gumbaz
aliases: Gol Gumbad, Mohammed Adil Shah Tomb
description: The mausoleum of Mohammed Adil Shah, featuring the second-largest unsupported dome in the world and an acoustic Whispering Gallery where echoes repeat 11 times.

name: Ibrahim Rauza
aliases: Ibrahim Roza, Ibrahim Adil Shah II Tomb
description: Exquisite 17th-century palatial mausoleum complex often referred to as the Taj Mahal of the Deccan for its elegant minarets, cupolas, and stone calligraphy.

name: Kalaburagi
aliases: Gulbarga, Kalaburagi City
description: Prominent cultural hub of the Kalyana-Karnataka region, former capital of the Bahmani kingdom, famous for the Gulbarga Fort and Sufi shrines.

name: Gulbarga Fort
aliases: Kalaburagi Fort, Jama Masjid Gulbarga Fort
description: 14th-century citadel expanded by Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah, housing the unique covered Jama Masjid modeled after the Spanish Mosque of Cordoba.

name: Khwaja Bande Nawaz Dargah
aliases: Dargah Hazrat Khwaja Bande Nawaz Gesudaraz, Gulbarga Dargah
description: Revered Sufi shrine complex dedicated to the 14th-century Chishti saint Hazrat Gesudaraz, attracting devotees of all faiths.

name: Sannati
aliases: Sannati Buddhist Site, Kanaganahalli, Ashokan Edicts Sannati, Chandralamba Temple
description: Major Buddhist archaeological site on the Bhima River where a monumental Maha Stupa and the only carved stone portrait of Emperor Ashoka were unearthed.

name: Hubballi
aliases: Hubli
description: Thriving commercial and industrial twin city to Dharwad, headquarters of South Western Railway with the world's longest railway platform at Shree Siddharoodha Swamiji station.

name: Dharwad
aliases: Dharwar
description: Educational and cultural center famous for Hindustani classical music heritage, Karnatak University, and the iconic Dharwad Pedha sweet.

name: Unkal Lake
aliases: Unkal Kere Hubli, Swami Vivekananda Statue Unkal Lake
description: Scenic 200-acre lake in Hubballi featuring a monumental statue of Swami Vivekananda in the center of the waters, lush recreational parks, and boating.

name: Gadag
aliases: Gadag Betageri, Gadag City
description: Historic city celebrated for Kalyani Chalukya stone art at Trikuteshwara and Veeranarayana temples, where poet Kumara Vyasa penned the Kannada Mahabharata.

name: Lakkundi
aliases: Lokkigundi, Lakkundi Temples and Stepwells, Brahma Jinalaya Lakkundi
description: Ancient Chalukyan temple village housing over 50 ornate stone shrines and stepped stepwells (Kalyani) with decorative stone carvings.

name: Koppal
aliases: Koppala, Koppal Fort
description: Historic district headquarters known for the hilltop Koppal Fort, rock edicts of Emperor Ashoka, and indigenous handcrafted Kinhal wooden toys.

name: Anegundi
aliases: Anegondi
description: Ancient fortified river village older than Hampi across the Tungabhadra River, identified as the mythical monkey kingdom of Kishkindha from the Ramayana.

name: Sanapur Lake
aliases: Sanapur Reservoir
description: Serene reservoir surrounded by dramatic granite boulder formations near Hampi, popular for traditional coracle boat rides and cliff walks.

name: Ballari
aliases: Bellary, Ballari Fort, Ballari City
description: Historic city overlooked by the monolithic Ballari Gudda rock hill crowned with the upper fort constructed by Hanumappa Nayaka and lower fort by Hyder Ali.

name: Daroji Sloth Bear Sanctuary
aliases: Daroji Bear Sanctuary, Daroji Hampi
description: Unique wildlife haven established in 1994 near Hampi specifically for the conservation and protection of the Indian sloth bear in rocky scrub forests.

name: Sandur
aliases: Sanduru, Kumaraswamy Temple Sandur, Sandur Valley
description: Picturesque valley surrounded by forested hills and mineral-rich ridges, home to the 8th-century Rashtrakuta Kumaraswamy and Parvati temple complex.

name: Davanagere
aliases: Davangere
description: Central commercial city celebrated throughout India for the Davanagere Benne Dosa (butter crepe), cotton textile history, and scenic lakes.

name: Shanthi Sagara
aliases: Sulekere, Soolekere, Shanthi Sagara Lake
description: One of the largest man-made irrigation tanks in Asia, constructed in 1128 AD across the Haridra river valley, spanning over 6,500 acres of water.

name: Haveri
aliases: Haveri Town, Siddheshwara Temple Haveri
description: Cultural district center known for historical 11th-century Western Chalukya architecture at Siddheshwara Temple and spicy Byadagi red chillies.

name: Ranebennur Blackbuck Sanctuary
aliases: Ranebennur Sanctuary, Blackbuck Sanctuary Haveri
description: Wildlife sanctuary established in 1958 protecting herds of endangered Indian blackbucks and the elusive great Indian bustard.

name: Kaginele
aliases: Kaginele Kanakadasa Smaraka, Kaginele Mahasamadhi
description: Birthplace and spiritual center of saint-philosopher Kanakadasa, featuring a memorial fort, museum, and the Keshava temple.

name: Raichur
aliases: Raichur City, Raichur Fort
description: Strategic fortress city between the Krishna and Tungabhadra rivers (Raichur Doab), rich in Kakatiya, Bahmani, and Vijayanagara history.

name: Yadgir
aliases: Yadgiri, Yadgir City, Hill Fort Yadgir
description: District headquarters known for the majestic Yadav hill fort resting atop a colossal monolithic rocky hill overlooking the town.

name: Somanathapura
aliases: Somanathapur, Somnathpura, Chennakeshava Temple Somanathapura, Keshava Temple Somanathapura
description: 13th-century UNESCO World Heritage Hoysala temple complex on the Kaveri River, famed for its trikuta star-shaped vimanas and detailed soapstone friezes.

name: Talakadu
aliases: Talakad, Talakadu Sand Dunes, Panchalinga Temples Talakadu
description: Historic temple town on the Kaveri River enveloped by sand dunes, famous for the five Shiva temples (Panchalingas) and Chola-Hoysala heritage.

name: Nanjangud
aliases: Nanjangudu, Sri Srikanteshwara Temple Nanjangud, Nanjundeshwara Temple
description: Ancient temple town on the banks of the Kapila (Kabini) River, revered for the monumental Sri Srikanteshwara (Nanjundeshwara) temple complex.

name: Kudalasangama
aliases: Kudala Sangama, Kudalasangam, Basaveshwara Aikya Mantapa
description: Sacred pilgrimage site at the confluence of the Krishna and Malaprabha rivers, housing the Aikya Mantapa of the 12th-century philosopher-statesman Jagadjyothi Basaveshwara.

name: Banavasi
aliases: Madhukeshwara Temple Banavasi, Vanavasi
description: Ancient capital of the Kadamba dynasty on the Varada River, celebrated as one of Karnataka's oldest historic settlements and home to the 9th-century Madhukeshwara Temple.

name: Sirsi
aliases: Sirsi Town, Marikamba Temple Sirsi, Sahasralinga Sirsi
description: Serene Malnad town in the Western Ghats surrounded by dense forests, known for the historic Sri Marikamba Temple, spice plantations, and riverbed Shivalingas at Sahasralinga.

name: Unchalli Falls
aliases: Lushington Falls, Keppa Joga
description: Dramatic 116-meter cataract created by the Aghanashini River tumbling down a steep rocky gorge in dense Sahyadri rainforests.

name: Honnavar
aliases: Honnavara, Sharavathi Eco Beach Honnavar, Honnavar Backwaters
description: Scenic coastal town on the Arabian Sea where the Sharavathi River meets the sea, renowned for boat cruises through mangrove forests and Blue Flag Eco Beach.

name: Basavakalyan
aliases: Kalyana, Basavakalyana, Basavakalyan Fort, Anubhava Mantapa
description: Historic capital of the Western Chalukya Empire and birthplace of the 12th-century Sharana social revolution led by Basavanna, featuring the Basavakalyan Fort and Anubhava Mantapa.

name: Mallalli Falls
aliases: Mallalli Waterfalls, Kumaradhara Falls Somwarpet
description: Spectacular stepped cascade in northern Kodagu formed by the Kumaradhara River tumbling down the northern slopes of the Pushpagiri mountain range.

name: Chelavara Falls
aliases: Chelavara Waterfalls, Embepare, Chomakund Chelavara
description: Natural cascade formed by a tributary of the Kaveri River rushing over a tortoise-shaped rock near Cheyandane, surrounded by coffee and cardamom plantations.

name: Ballalarayana Durga
aliases: Ballalarayana Durga Fort, Ballalarayanadurga
description: Isolated 12th-century hilltop fort ruins built by the Hoysala dynasty atop a high Western Ghats ridge near Kalasa, offering sweeping panoramic valley views.

name: Rani Jhari
aliases: Rani Jhari View Point, Rani Jhari Edge
description: Mesmerizing cliff-edge viewpoint near Kalasa overlooking deep green Western Ghats gorges and waterfalls tumbling into the Netravati valley.

name: Padubidri Beach
aliases: Padubidri Blue Flag Beach, Padubidri Sea Beach
description: Internationally certified Blue Flag beach known for pristine clean sands, safe swimming zones, water sports, and well-maintained seaside promenades.

name: Barkur
aliases: Barakanur, Barkuru, Alupa Capital Barkur
description: Ancient coastal capital of the Alupa dynasty on the Seetha River, home to ruins of laterite fortresses, Jain basadis, and historic stone temples.

name: St. Aloysius Chapel
aliases: Saint Aloysius Chapel Mangalore, Aloysius Chapel
description: 1899 Catholic chapel atop Light House Hill in Mangaluru, famous for magnificent frescoes and oil canvas paintings by Italian Jesuit painter Antony Moscheni.

name: Pilikula Nisargadhama
aliases: Pilikula Biological Park, Pilikula Science Centre
description: Integrated eco-education and tourism park near Mangaluru featuring a biological wildlife park, 3D planetarium, heritage village, and boating lake.

name: Channapatna
aliases: Channapatna City, Channapattana, Channapatna Toys City
description: Town celebrated across India for traditional lacquerware wooden toys and handicrafts crafted by local artisans using natural dyes and ivory wood.

name: Bheemeshwari
aliases: Bheemeshwari Nature Camp, Bheemeshwari Cauvery Camp
description: Eco-tourism haven situated along the Kaveri River, surrounded by dense forests home to elephants, leopards, crocodiles, and adventure activities like zip-lining and rafting.

name: Galibore
aliases: Galibore Nature Camp, Galibore Fishing Camp
description: Secluded wilderness camp tucked deep inside deciduous forests along the Kaveri River, famous for nature trails, coracle rides, and birdwatching.

name: Nrityagram
aliases: Nrityagram Dance Village, Hesaraghatta Nrityagram
description: India's first modern Gurukul dance community founded by Protima Gauri near Hesaraghatta, renowned for preserving classical Odissi and Bharatnatyam arts in earthen architecture.

name: Hesaraghatta Lake
aliases: Hesaraghatta Kere, Hesaraghatta Grasslands
description: Expansive man-made freshwater reservoir built across the Arkavathi River in 1894, surrounded by scenic open grasslands popular among birdwatchers and cyclists.

name: Avani
aliases: Avani Betta, Ramalingeshwara Temple Avani, Sita Mata Temple Avani
description: Sacred historic village nestled below a rocky hill, famous for the 10th-century Nolamba-style Ramalingeshwara temple complex and legendary association with Maharshi Valmiki.

name: Kurudumale
aliases: Kurudumale Ganesha Temple, Kurudumale Maha Ganapathi
description: Sacred temple village home to a colossal 13.5-foot monolithic idol of Lord Ganesha sculpted during the Vijayanagara era, alongside the Chola-period Someshwara temple.

name: Magadi Bird Sanctuary
aliases: Magadi Kere, Magadi Wetland Gadag, Bar-headed Goose Sanctuary
description: Internationally significant wetland tank in Shirahatti taluk that hosts thousands of migratory Bar-headed Geese flying from Mongolia across the Himalayas during winter.

name: Itagi Mahadeva Temple
aliases: Itagi Temple, Mahadeva Temple Itagi, Devalaya Chakravarti
description: Masterpiece of Western Chalukya architecture completed in 1112 AD by Mahadeva Dandanayaka, praised in historical stone inscriptions as 'Devalaya Chakravarti' (Emperor among Temples).

name: Bankapura Peacock Sanctuary
aliases: Bankapura Fort Peacock Sanctuary, Bankapur
description: Sanctuary established inside the 9th-century ruined moat and ramparts of Bankapura Fort, protecting breeding colonies of Indian Peafowl and the ancient Nagareshwara temple.

name: Godchinamalaki Falls
aliases: Markandeya Falls, Godchinamalaki Waterfalls
description: Picturesque two-tiered waterfall on the Markandeya River cascading through a lush green rocky valley near Gokak.

name: Hidkal Dam
aliases: Raja Lakhamagouda Dam, Hidkal Reservoir, Ghataprabha Dam
description: Major water reservoir across the Ghataprabha River in Hukkeri taluk, attracting migratory birds and offering scenic vistas across broad backwaters.

name: Shahapur Sleeping Buddha Hill
aliases: Sleeping Buddha Hill Shahapur, Shahapur Hill View
description: Unique horizontal rock formation comprising four contiguous hills near Shahapur that resembles the silhouette of the reclining Gautama Buddha.
